reason: I'd open the free version and try the Sunday cook-ahead plan, because that fits how I cook. But I won't pay 99 baht up front for a pack that doesn't exist yet when I don't even know if the free dishes come out right in my kitchen.
objection: Will the dish actually come out right with my stove, my pans and the ingredients at my market? YouTube is free and my mother is a phone call away, so an app has to prove itself before I pay.
would_change_my_mind: Cooking two or three of the free dishes on a Sunday and having them come out right for my family, with the 40-baht-a-meal plan holding true at my market. Then I'd buy the 12-dish pack once it's actually out.
